nodes.label: The Underledger
nodes.effect: Show old creditor, duty/debt outstanding, wallet and real chip state; do not clear existing obligations

nodes.label: Matron Wisp
nodes.rule: One relic buyback at floor(original price/2), buyer must have actual funds, optional; no refills

nodes.label: The Underlamp Table
nodes.win: player>=1 chip AND finishes top two
nodes.alive_failure: still proceed to hearing, no chip penalty, conditional writ locked
nodes.win_effect: grant under_writ_eligible flag, once only; service/debt progress from standard table events

nodes.label: The Petition of Cinders
nodes.rule: If no active debt or duties, grant free passage to Crown Writ via Favor -1 petition (min -3). If bound AND under_writ_eligible AND not overdue, grant conditional Crown Writ, retain contracts, Favor -1 (min -3), first Crown Table hand public notice of bound status. Otherwise living Undercircuit ending. No obligation forgiven.

nodes.label: The Low Lanterns Remain
nodes.effect: Survive with exact chips and obligations, archived continuation; no free funds or status reset

accounting: All wallets sourced once from 102; no repeated Underlamp farming; if player has 0 chips, resolve existing Last Claim first (normally second bankrupt death).
